target.alpha: rate of improvement in useful pre-commitment information under a declared q(t) model
target.beta: rate of decay in independently calibrated retained actionability under a declared r(t) model
target.theorem_role: dimensionless exponential-witness coordinate, not a universal natural parameter

qualification_rules: q(t) must be calibrated independently of focal action outcomes
r(t) must have a biological mapping to retained action-changing capacity; route distance, stopover count, lambda, or window duration alone are insufficient
the functional forms used to estimate alpha and beta must be prespecified or validated independently
q and r must refer to the same decision stages and biological action
waiting cost D(t) must be negligible or separately modeled before interpreting chi as sufficient

candidates.primary_q_note: focal analysis uses rolling pre-focal NARR predictive connectivity, not these static published values
candidates.reason_q: the source-backed static short-window sequence is non-monotone and focal rolling q remains unexecuted
candidates.reason_r: transit compression, route skipping, remaining route distance and stopover structure are recourse evidence/proxies but no declared mapping identifies reduced-form r

candidates.evidence: three flyways, 16 stopover regions; predictability varies strongly with ecological barriers
candidates.reason_q: predictability is route-pair specific and can rise or fall across barriers rather than following one exponential information-gain curve
candidates.reason_r: phase-retention lambda and stopover slopes quantify realized correction, not the probability/weight that a later cue can still change the focal action

candidates.reason: registered connectivity x phase-correction interaction was not supported; neither quantity supplies a direct r mapping

valid_next_steps: retain alpha/beta exponential model as exact theoretical witness and comparative coordinate
for natural systems use the general q(t), r(t), D(t) first-order condition unless functional forms are independently justified
execute the frozen greater-snow-goose q and compensation lanes without back-solving r
develop an independent actionability calibration before estimating natural beta
forbidden: fit alpha to three or four source-published q points after inspecting their shape and call it natural information rate
set r equal to fraction of route remaining
set beta equal to phase-correction rate k_eq
compare taxa by chi until both alpha and beta are independently qualified
